structure_policy_rationale: Original 图标主体为文字排版，属于清晰的几何符号类。根据 theme_rules，当 Original 为文字或清晰符号时，应保留其主体轮廓和空间布局。因此，必须保留“英雄联盟”四字的整体骨架和右下角星形的位置关系，不能将其重构为其他抽象图形，否则将失去作为官方助手的识别度。
preserve: 中文“英雄联盟”四字的整体拓扑结构和左右排列顺序
右下角星形/十字符号的放射状形态和相对位置
must_preserve: “英雄联盟”四个汉字的可读性轮廓
右下角折角区域内的白色抽象符号（简化为星形）
品牌标志性的深蓝底色倾向（映射为主题靛蓝）
recompose_allowed: 将锐利的字体衬线和直角转化为圆润、钝角的手绘块面
将金属质感、渐变和高光替换为纯色平涂
将复杂的背景流光效果彻底移除
简化星形符号的内部细节，使其符合涂鸦风格
restyle: 字体风格：从标准印刷体转变为粗犷、不规则的马克笔/蜡笔手写体
材质：从光滑金属/玻璃质感转变为哑光、颗粒感的干性绘画介质质感
边缘：从平滑矢量边缘转变为抖动、毛糙的手绘边缘
decorate: 在文字块面和星形符号周围添加粗重的黑色手绘轮廓线
保持构图松散自由，不追求严格对称
forbid: 保留原始图标的蓝色渐变背景和金属光泽
使用细线条、无描边或完美的矢量风格
将中文品牌名替换为英文、通用游戏图标或无关图形
使用主题色板（红、蓝、黄/白、黑）以外的颜色（如浅青、亮绿、紫色）
添加阴影、投影、高光或3D立体效果
generation_brief: Retro hand-drawn doodle icon on pure black background. Centered thick blocky Chinese characters '英雄联盟' in flat indigo blue or creamy yellow, with rough uneven black marker outlines. Bottom-right corner features a simplified star/cross symbol in brick red or cream, also with thick black doodle outline. Flat colors only, no gradients, no shadows, no metallic texture. Crayon/marker texture, naive art style, high saturation limited palette.
color_application: Map original deep blue background to theme's Indigo/Dark Blue solid block for the text body. Map original orange/gold accents to theme's Brick Red or Creamy Yellow for the star symbol and potential text highlights. Strictly avoid gradients; use solid flat fills from the limited palette (Red, Blue, Yellow/White).
stroke_application: Apply thick, irregular, hand-drawn black outlines around the Chinese characters and the star symbol. Ensure lines have varying thickness and jittery edges to simulate marker pen strokes. No clean vector lines.
composition_application: Center the '英雄联盟' text block to occupy ~60-70% of the canvas. Place the simplified star symbol in the bottom-right area relative to the text, maintaining the original spatial relationship but flattening the depth. Keep ample black negative space around the subject.
identity_application: Preserve the specific geometric structure of the four Chinese characters '英雄联盟' to ensure legibility and brand recognition. Retain the bottom-right star symbol as a key visual anchor. Transform the visual style (texture, color, stroke) to match the theme while keeping the semantic layout intact.
fidelity_constraints: Must apply thick, rough, hand-drawn black outlines
Colors must be restricted to high-saturation Red, Blue, Yellow/White flat fills
No gradients, shadows, lighting effects, or 3D rendering
Subject must appear as flat, clumsy, cute geometric blocks
negative_constraints: No realistic, photorealistic, or 3D rendered elements
No glossy, metallic, or glass textures
No fine, smooth, or perfect vector lines
No colors outside the theme palette (e.g., green, purple, cyan)
Do not remove or replace the Chinese text '英雄联盟'
Do not remove the bottom-right star symbol
